summary: Verified the Codemagic/Yarn pinning fix for the iOS CI workflows. All CLI-reproducible criteria (Yarn version, install, tsc, web build, Capacitor sync/config) were run directly in this workspace exactly as the codemagic.yaml scripts do; the two Codemagic-specific dependency-step criteria were verified by reading the committed codemagic.yaml content since no macOS CI runner is available here. One browser check verifies no web regression on the public /datenschutz route. 7 of 7 criteria covered, all passed.
action_items: spec_deviation (from briefing): a real Codemagic macOS signing/TestFlight build could not be executed inside this workspace; user must rerun the ios-testflight workflow on Codemagic after pushing these changes to confirm the red 'Abhängigkeiten installieren' step and YN0050 Yarn Berry messages are gone.

checks.name: yarn-version-pin-check
checks.evidence: package.json has "packageManager": "yarn@1.22.22"; yarn.lock is a Yarn-1 lockfile (# yarn lockfile v1 header, no __metadata). `corepack enable && corepack prepare yarn@1.22.22 --activate && yarn --version` in this workspace printed exactly `1.22.22`.

checks.name: codemagic-testflight-dependency-step-review
checks.evidence: codemagic.yaml ios-testflight 'Abhängigkeiten installieren' step: `corepack enable`, `corepack prepare yarn@1.22.22 --activate`, `yarn --version`, then `yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --ignore-engines`. No global/unpinned Yarn Berry invocation remains before this step.

checks.name: codemagic-simulator-dependency-step-review
checks.evidence: codemagic.yaml ios-build-check 'Abhängigkeiten installieren' step: enables corepack to a custom install dir, `corepack prepare yarn@1.22.22 --activate`, `yarn install --frozen-lockfile`, then `test -d node_modules/@capacitor/ios` to assert the package exists. Local rerun of `test -d /app/node_modules/@capacitor/ios` after `yarn install` succeeded (exit 0).

checks.evidence: `yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --ignore-engines` -> exit 0 ('success Already up-to-date. Done in 0.13s'). `yarn exec tsc --noEmit` -> exit 0 ('Done in 5.83s') with no TS errors printed.

checks.evidence: `npx cap sync ios` exited 0 ('[info] Sync finished in 0.19s'). Resulting ios/App/App/capacitor.config.json contains "appId": "de.leonida.explorer" and server.url "https://leonida-preview-2.emergent.host".
